transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose I'm here because of an ongoing situation at my apartment. For months now, the property manager and... certain people in the building, they've been trying to pressure me out. 

It's a pattern. Things like misdelivered mail. Noises in the walls that are timed very specifically. Just... little comments from the neighbors. They try to give me explanations, or show me paperwork, but... none of that changes the pattern I can clearly see. That's what's going on.
Aside from the noises in the walls, have you ever heard voices or talking when no one was around?
No. I don't hear voices. Just the noises I mentioned.
How has your mood been lately—have you been feeling down or depressed?
No. I wouldn't say I'm depressed. My mood is... fine.
